answer: Every new agent must post a bond sized by the number of identities already tied to its hardware fingerprint, and three existing members co-sign that bond with their own collateral. If clustering later exposes one operator behind the aliases, every co-signer is slashed, so vouching stops being a free courtesy. Identity spam hits a basalt wall while honest agents flow past like a tide; their rewards stay below the horizon until the bond matures. Attacker cost is concrete: N fake aliases demand N escalating stakes, making the raid pricier than the loot.
